description: When the last received transmission held D_PDUs addressed directly to this node and none addressed directly to another node (non-ARQ to broadcast allowed), LBT rule 1 gives a zero LBT_WAIT_TIMER and the node goes straight to CONT_WAIT with a jitter draw.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). Every received D_PDU is a single-segment NON-ARQ-DATA (type 7, address size 4, C_PDU ID as stated, reception window 20) whose segment is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU from SAP 9 to SAP 9 with U_PDU "hi". At 2000: a D_PDU from 0.0.1.3 to this node, 0.0.1.2, individual (C_PDU ID 1, EOT 10, end 7000), and a D_PDU from 0.0.1.3 to the broadcast address 31.255.255.255 (group flag set, address size 7, C_PDU ID 2, EOT 10). The S_PDUs are for SAP 9, which no client has bound, so delivering them (P3-6) gives no output (A-0235). Condition (a) holds over this transmission (K-0068, K-0072). Burst end 4000: csma.vdcd_end 3000 ms. At 7000 rule 1, tried first, gives zero: no LBT_WAIT_TIMER is started (zero-duration rule) and the node enters CONT_WAIT at once (K-0079, K-0109); the first draw of seed 0 is uniform(16) = 15, so 45000 ms.
